subject: Fix test_reclaimFilePageCache to avoid tmpfs (#1379)
reason: The change modifies only src/unit/test_util.c, adding a statfs check so the unit test test_reclaimFilePageCache skips itself based on whether /tmp is tmpfs (where posix_fadvise page-cache reclaim can't be observed). It is a test-infrastructure/CI fix with no change to any server, command, replication, persistence, or tool behaviour, so no fuzzer scenario can exercise it and none is needed.
